# KREATO.AI — AI Agents for Polish SMB Companies

## About
KREATO.AI builds AI voice bots, chatbots, and automation agents for Polish small and medium businesses.

## Products
- **Karolina AI** — 24/7 AI receptionist voicebot (Polish language). Answers calls, books appointments, handles FAQ. From 399 PLN/month.
- **Chatbot AI** — website chatbot
- **SMM + Reels AI** — automated social media content generation
- **Reklama FB/IG** — Facebook and Instagram ad management
- **KREATO Serwis** — field service management: job intake, crew scheduling, calendar, PDF protocols. Pilot program, see /serwis.html

## Pricing
- Karolina AI Starter: 399 PLN net/month (200 min)
- Karolina AI Business: 499 PLN net/month (400 min)
- Karolina AI Pro Max: 699 PLN net/month (600 min)
- Configuration: 599 PLN one-time

## Technical
- Powered by LiveKit (voice AI), n8n (automation), Supabase
- Languages: Polish (primary), English on request
- Pilot time: 2-3 business days
